subject: Pegasus Systems — vendor activation, payment cadence and advance-pay request
messages:
From: Emily Kaye <emily.kaye@pegasus-sys.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@pegasus-sys.com
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding / payment cadence question (Pegasus Systems)

Hi Hannah,

We're excited to get Redwood live for our observability integration. Procurement asked I reach out to confirm payment cadence and whether Pegasus can enroll in any accelerated remit program while onboarding. A few specifics: 

- We expect an initial PO for Q4 professional services + first month of consumption.
- Our standard is Net45, but the AP team asked if Net30 is possible for the initial invoices.
- We can accept Net45 if there's an option to request a one-off early-pay discount (we'd consider a 1%–1.5% discount in return for payment inside 10–15 days).

Attached: Pegasus_onboarding_form.pdf, W9_Pegasus.pdf.

Can you advise the typical Redwood onboarding timeline and whether your AP team supports short-term accelerated payment/discount arrangements for new customers? If so, what approvals are needed and what details you need back from our side?

Thanks — Emily

Emily Kaye
Procurement Lead, Pegasus Systems
emily.kaye@pegasus-sys.com
+1 (415) 555-0199

Attachments: Pegasus_onboarding_form.pdf (application), W9_Pegasus.pdf (tax form)

From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Kaye <emily.kaye@pegasus-sys.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 15:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding / payment cadence question (Pegasus Systems)

Hi Emily — thanks for the details and for sending the forms. Welcome aboard. Quick answers and next steps below.

Summary:
- Standard onboarding/activation for a commercial customer is 7–10 business days after we receive the completed onboarding form + PO and tax docs.
- Our default payment term is Net45 for new customers in the enterprise flow, but we can evaluate Net30 or an early-pay discount on a case-by-case basis.
- For an accelerated remit discount we need: completed onboarding form (you've started this — thank you), a formal PO with invoice header, and the AP contact for the remittance email. Finance approval typically takes 1–2 business days once those items are provided.

Can you send:
1) The PO with exact invoice-to/ship-to headers and billing contact.
2) The AP remittance email and preferred ACH/wire instructions (if you want to enroll in accelerated remit).

I've attached our onboarding checklist to make this easier: vendor-intake-checklist.pdf. I'll loop in David (AP) here to review early-pay discount feasibility. Monica — adding you for onboarding handoff and activation calendar.

Next steps:
- Emily: send PO + AP contact
- David: will review discount options and prepare a short terms draft if approved
- Hannah/Monica: schedule activation once docs and PO are confirmed

Best,
Hannah
Director, Partnerships Operations
Redwood Inference
H: hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com

Attachments: vendor-intake-checklist.pdf (checklist)

From: David Kim <david.kim@redwoodinference.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Emily Kaye <emily.kaye@pegasus-sys.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 09:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding / payment cadence question (Pegasus Systems)

Emily / Hannah — I reviewed the request with Finance. We can offer an Accelerated Remittance discount; a couple of items and options below.

What we need from Pegasus:
- Final PO (PDF) with invoice header exactly as it should appear on invoices.
- Confirmation of remit method (ACH or wire) and remittance email.
- Completed onboarding form (we received the draft, thank you) and W9.

Discount options we can approve at the onboarding stage (subject to PO + docs):
- Option A: 1.5% discount if payment is received within 10 calendar days of invoice date (requires finance manager sign-off).
- Option B: 1.0% discount if payment is received within 15 calendar days (operationally easier; can be approved at the AP director level).

Emily — if Pegasus prefers Option B (1.0% / 15 days) we'll prepare an amendment/short addendum and route it via DocuSign. If you prefer Option A, that will take an extra day for the manager sign-off but is still doable.

I've attached a short draft that we use for the early-pay addendum (earlypay-terms-draft.docx). Once we have the PO + confirmed remit method I'll send the DocuSign link.

Marissa — can you keep the account team in the loop for activation timing and any commercial concessions?

Thanks,
David
Head of Finance Operations, Redwood Inference

Attachments: earlypay-terms-draft.docx (draft addendum)

From: Emily Kaye <emily.kaye@pegasus-sys.com>

Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 11:46:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding / payment cadence question (Pegasus Systems)

Thanks David — good summary. Pegasus prefers Option B given our internal approvals: 1.0% discount if payment is received within 15 days. That's easier for our AP to operationalize.

Attached: Pegasus_onboarding_form_filled.pdf (completed), PO_6372_Pegasus.pdf (PO) — PO includes invoice header and billing contact. Remittance method: ACH, remittance@pegasus-sys.com.

We'd like Redwood to target activation next Monday (2026-10-19) so our integration and kickoff are aligned with the start of the paid period. Please confirm any blocking items.
